## Verdict: ADMIT_FOR_OWNER_REVIEW

**PNGs actually inspected (all eight):** `before-viewport-1440.png`, `after-viewport-1440.png`, `before-viewport-390.png`, `after-viewport-390.png`, `banner-390.png`, `directory-closed-1440.png`, `directory-closed-390.png`, `shortcuts-1440.png`.

**Source bound:** HTML `e44657f518fcd27810a2895080b34835b2fa60d6fb8481f4ae42ceb30f7ed977` (matches `sourceSha256` in browser-checks.json); runtime `281e247abba7e10e5594a0ad8eab17912d2403074c2e3e0a778b23c99a3e7fe5`; Worker unchanged at `9ddfba4179ce757019a2bacf75dbc814a222410628821b17c5feaba09337e764`. I read files only; no writes. I have no shell here, so hashes are bound as stated/receipt-corroborated, not recomputed by me.

**What the pixels show.** Order is masthead → slim Did you know → six illustrated shortcuts → collapsed directory, as requested. `shortcuts-1440.png` shows all six original cards with original artwork and palette intact, 3×2, no clipped text or broken images; 390 stacks cleanly with image-above-copy and no horizontal overflow (checks: overflow 1440/390 = viewport width, errors empty). `directory-closed-1440/390.png` show the original eyebrow, "Everything you can do in LAiDIES." heading and intro with a full-width lime pill "Show the full directory +" — unmistakable, and full width at both sizes. `before-viewport-*` confirm the four categories and links that the closed state now hides; checks report categories 4 / directLinks 26 retained on expand, plus the KSVL pill still inside the disclosure.

**Routes and journeys.** "I want to learn" → `/learn.html`; the broad AI question → `/learn.html#help-now` (not Miss Jeeves), matching scope. NewsStand, episode, radio and fun-connect cards keep their data hooks; the after-1440 headline card renders live copy and `episodeRollover` shows published-only rollover.

**Banner.** Slim strip under the masthead, header-width, reusing existing feature artwork. Disclosure is native `<details>` (keyboard + no-JS expansion verified); controls ship `hidden` and are revealed by JS, so no dead buttons without JS. Autoplay starts paused under `prefers-reduced-motion`, pauses on hover, focus and offscreen, with a persistent Pause/Play toggle; motion-check PASS at ~8.5s intervals.

**Non-blocking notes for the owner, not defects:** the banner rotation was trimmed from six highlights to four (both dropped destinations remain in the directory), and `#today` now anchors the shortcuts section rather than the directory. Neither changes an existing journey.

No decision-changing blockers found.
